PointTreeMarcher< AccT, RayT, CoordT > Class Template Reference
An offset by 0.5 is applied to the ray to account for the fact that points in vdb grids are bucketed into so-called grid cell, which are centered round grid voxels, whereas the DDA is based on so-called grid nodes, which are coincident with grid voxels.
